evidence.reason: The wrapper explicitly forwards termination signals to the active child, but omits SIGHUP, which also terminates the Node wrapper by default. A SIGHUP sent to the wrapper PID therefore exits the wrapper before markBuildComplete(), while the non-detached child can continue running and writing dist. Adding SIGHUP to the forwarded signal list is a small ordinary signal-handling fix, with child exit resolving to status 1 as with the other forwarded signals.
